scope: Curated reference of 16 verified major oil and gas operators in Nigeria across the national oil company (NNPC Limited), 5 international oil company (IOC) groups active in Nigeria, Nigeria LNG Limited (incorporated midstream LNG joint venture), and 9 major indigenous upstream, refining, and downstream operators — reflecting verified 2024–2026 onshore/shallow-water divestments and corporate renamings. Explicitly excludes minor retail filling-station brands, oilfield service contractors, unverified modular refinery proposals, live crude oil price feeds, and equity investment advice.
notes: Under Nigeria's Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021, technical and commercial oversight is split between the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) for exploration and production and the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority (NMDPRA) for gas processing, LNG, refining, depots, and retail marketing. Between August 2024 and March 2025, three landmark divestments reshaped onshore and shallow-water operatorship: Eni completed the sale of Nigerian Agip Oil Company (NAOC) to Oando Plc (August 2024), ExxonMobil completed the sale of Mobil Producing Nigeria Unlimited (MPNU) to Seplat Energy Plc as SEPNU (December 2024), and Shell completed the sale of SPDC to Renaissance Africa Energy Company Limited (March 2025), while the IOCs retained deepwater and LNG stakes.

operators.operationsSummary: Originally incorporated in 1960 for downstream marketing, converted into National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc (NOLCHEM), and renamed Conoil Plc in January 2003 following privatisation to Conpetro Limited, Conoil Plc is one of Nigeria's oldest NGX-listed major petroleum marketers. It distributes PMS, diesel, aviation turbine kerosene (Jet A-1), LPG, and branded lubricants across retail stations, commercial/industrial clients, and airport aviation depots nationwide.
keyAssets: Nationwide retail filling-station network, Apapa coastal depot, and regional storage depots
Aviation refuelling depots supplying domestic and international carriers at major Nigerian airports
Lubricants manufacturing and blending lines alongside household and industrial LPG distribution
